parsed.note_claim: The video is from an explosion on the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to Crimea, not the King Fahd Causeway in Bahrain.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Crimean Bridge is a pair of parallel bridges... spanning the Kerch Strait between Russia on the east side and Crimea in Ukraine on the west side.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the Crimean Bridge (Kerch Bridge) links Russia to Crimea, substantiating the location claim and distinguishing it from other locations.
